Game Overview

In RedLand Water is life, the core idea is straightforward: guide the red people through Redland's vibrant, pixelated world, strategically finding and transporting water amidst rising levels. Skillfully balance urgency with caution, collecting valuable purple cubes for mechanical boosts. Navigate this thrilling quest to quench your people's thirst and overcome high-stakes challenges with each daring decision.
